metadata.description: Agent skills for working with Hex's AI agents and analytics platform.

plugins.name: hex-context-best-practices
plugins.description: Advise on and draft Hex context assets (endorsements, descriptions, workspace context/guides, semantic models), plan a phased Threads rollout, and diagnose wrong agent answers.

plugins.name: looker-migration
plugins.description: Migrate Looker dashboards/Looks into Hex: translate LookML + Looker's generated SQL, let Hex's notebook agent build a generative app on gated SQL cells, and verify with a SQL-fidelity gate (numeric parity vs Looker) + a visual-QA loop.

plugins.name: tableau-migration
plugins.description: Migrate Tableau dashboards/workbooks into Hex: parse the .twb into a migration brief, let Hex's notebook agent build a generative app on gated SQL cells, and verify with a SQL-fidelity gate + a visual-QA loop.
